prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, a 1930s basement seen side-on and wide like a lit stage, now a perfectly innocent bread kitchen: on the left, where printing presses stood, a row of brick bread ovens glowing warm orange under hanging lamps, wooden racks of golden loaves, flour dusted over everything; the band of gangsters on the little stage with scarlet curtains now wear tall white baker's hats and white aprons over their pinstripe suits, holding rolling pins and trays instead of instruments, smiling innocently; a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache stands on a table in the middle holding a long loaf, beaming innocently. On the right wall, a huge iron lever pulled all the way down, a young gangster with slicked red hair and freckles leaning on it, whistling. Most of the frame warm shadow; the brightest values are the oven mouths and the golden loaves. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
